The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid Mk. I, better known as the Vulture Droid, is a small unmanned starfighter that relies on overwhelming numbers to defeat its enemies. Lightly armored and armed, it compensates with high speed, strong maneuverability, and a small target profile that makes it difficult to hit in a dogfight. Produced in untold millions by Baktoid Armor Workshop and Haor Chall Engineering, Vulture Droids were a mainstay of Trade Federation naval forces before becoming a core component of the Confederacy’s war machine. Degraded by neglect and corrosion, these models have reduced structural integrity.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid Mk. I, better known as the Vulture Droid, is a small unmanned starfighter that relies on overwhelming numbers to defeat its enemies. Lightly armored and armed, it compensates with high speed, strong maneuverability, and a small target profile that makes it difficult to hit in a dogfight. Produced in untold millions by Baktoid Armor Workshop and Haor Chall Engineering, Vulture Droids were a mainstay of Trade Federation naval forces before becoming a core component of the Confederacy’s war machine. Best employed in large groups, Vulture squadrons can overwhelm isolated enemies, but struggle in one-on-one engagements against even poorly trained organic pilots.

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid Mk. II, better known as the Heavy Vulture Droid, is a small unmanned starfighter that relies on overwhelming numbers to defeat its enemies. Based on the original Mk. I design, this variant has been modified to carry Discord Missiles, greatly improving its effectiveness against enemy starfighters. Lightly armored and armed, it compensates with high speed, strong maneuverability, and a small target profile that makes it difficult to hit in dogfights. Produced in untold millions by Baktoid Armor Workshop and Haor Chall Engineering, Heavy Vulture Droids serve as an upgraded component of the Confederacy’s war machine. Best employed in large groups, Vulture squadrons can overwhelm isolated enemies, but struggle in one-on-one engagements against even poorly trained organic pilots.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

The Droid Tri-Fighter, designed by Colicoid Creation Nest, is a highly advanced unmanned space superiority starfighter built to outclass earlier droid designs. Manufactured by Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries and Colla Designs, Tri-Fighters were far more complex and expensive than other droid counterparts, limiting their production numbers. Equipped with a significantly more sophisticated droid brain than the Vulture Droid, they demonstrate faster reaction times and far greater combat efficiency. Extremely small and compact, the Tri-Fighter combines incredible speed and maneuverability with a heavy weapons loadout. Armed with a central medium laser cannon, three wing-mounted light laser cannons, and Discord Missiles, they excel as interceptors, performing high-speed hit-and-run strikes against vulnerable targets such as bombers and gunships.

Required Planets (CIS, Underworld, Rebel, Neutral, Empire): Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost
Special Structures (CIS): CIS_Shipyard_1

Designed and built by Haor Chall Engineering for in-atmosphere airstrikes, the Heavy Missile Platform (HMP) Droid is a compact but heavily armed gunship. In space, it serves as a capable fire-support craft, using its powerful missile payload and mix of light, medium, and heavy laser cannons to engage both starfighters and larger targets. Twin turret-mounted repeating light laser cannons provide wide firing arcs and sustained coverage, making the HMP dangerous in a dogfight when supported by allied craft. Degraded by neglect and corrosion, these junk models have reduced structural integrity.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

Designed and built by Haor Chall Engineering for in-atmosphere airstrikes, the Heavy Missile Platform (HMP) Droid is a compact but heavily armed gunship. In space, it serves as a capable fire-support craft, using its powerful missile payload and mix of light, medium, and heavy laser cannons to engage both starfighters and larger targets. The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid Mk. III, better known as the Hyena Droid Bomber, is a larger unmanned strike craft derived from the Vulture Droid design. Sharing the same general shape and performance characteristics, the Hyena trades some agility for increased payload capacity, with an offset droid brain and dedicated ordnance pod for proton torpedoes. Produced in untold millions by Baktoid Armor Workshop, Hyena Droids serve as the primary bomber element of the Confederacy’s starfighter forces. While capable of holding its own in a dogfight thanks to its high speed and respectable maneuverability, the Hyena excels in attack runs against larger targets, delivering powerful torpedo strikes before disengaging.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid Mk. IV, better known as the Advanced Hyena Droid Bomber, is an upgraded unmanned strike craft derived from the Vulture Droid design. Sharing the same general shape and performance characteristics, this variant features reinforced armor, advanced proton torpedoes, and an anti-starfighter missile launcher, greatly improving its combat effectiveness against both capital ships and enemy fighters. Produced in untold millions by Baktoid Armor Workshop, Advanced Hyena Droids serve as an enhanced bomber element of the Confederacy’s starfighter forces. While capable of holding its own in a dogfight thanks to its high speed and respectable maneuverability, the Advanced Hyena excels in attack runs against larger targets, delivering powerful torpedo strikes before disengaging.

Serving as a high-end interceptor for the Separatist Navy, it combines extreme speed and maneuverability with a powerful and versatile weapons loadout. High-velocity heavy laser cannons and medium repeating lasers allow the Nighthawk to tear through armored targets, while concussion missiles and an underslung ion cannon turret make it deadly at close range. The Belbullab-22 Interceptor, designed and built on Utapau by Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies, is an unusual sight among CIS forces as a manned starfighter equipped with a hyperdrive. Known for its sturdy construction, the Belbullab combines moderate shielding with durable armor, allowing it to withstand punishment that would quickly destroy lighter droid craft. Its powerful engines provide strong straight-line acceleration, though it suffers from a wide turning radius under boost. Armed with rapid-fire triple light laser cannons and concussion missiles, the Belbullab is a capable general-purpose fighter. While not exceptional in any one area, its survivability, flexibility, and reliance on skilled organic pilots make it a reliable and effective alternative to standard droid starfighters.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

One of the few manned starfighters in CIS service, the hardy Utapauan Porax-38 features high-capacity shields and thick cortosis-inlaid armor capable of limited blaster deflection, and is well known for its deadly hit-and-run performance. Its twin repeating TAU-9 medium laser cannons, while somewhat inaccurate and short-ranged, are capable of sustained fire, making the Porax-38 a lethal weapon against unsuspecting foes. While durable, the Porax presents a large target profile when maneuvering and suffers from generally poor handling. This leaves it vulnerable to missile-armed craft in dogfights, where it relies on countermeasure flares to survive. Despite these shortcomings, its durability, firepower, and customizability made it a favored craft among bounty hunters and pirates long after the Clone Wars.

The Cutlass-9 Patrol Fighter is a heavy multirole starfighter manufactured by SoroSuub Corporation prior to the Clone Wars. Originally intended for SoroSuub’s own defense forces, the company supplied large numbers of them to its Confederate allies after Sullust seceded from the Republic early in the war. Following the conflict, the design became common among planetary defense forces and pirate bands.

A large and unwieldy two-seat craft built for long-range patrols, the Cutlass-9 features strong armor and shielding, a hyperdrive, and a versatile weapons loadout. Medium laser cannons, proton torpedo launchers, and a variable-use cannon capable of firing ion shots or light flak shells allow it to disable warships or tear through enemy fighters. Despite its heavy armament and durability, the Cutlass-9 handles poorly and is ill-suited for dogfighting.

Slow, lumbering, and devastating, the Condor is a Trade Federation heavy droid bomber design from the pre-war era, later refitted for the Separatists to carry high-yield proton missiles. These heavy warheads are capable of partially bypassing shields and inflicting mild damage, but their true strength lies in the catastrophic area-of-effect devastation they cause to unshielded vessels and clustered formations, and Heavy repeating laser cannons can provide sustained lethal fire against corvettes or other targets too small for the deadly missiles to hit. Though expensive to field and vulnerable to enemy interceptors, Condors can decisively alter the course of a battle when unleashed in numbers, earning them a reputation as one of the most destructive droid bombers ever deployed.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

During the Clone Wars, Asajj Ventress served as the feared dark acolyte and prospective apprentice of Count Dooku. While adept in lightsaber combat with her twin blades, Ventress was also one of the finest pilots in the galaxy. Many met their end at her hands. After the war, her relationship with the Separatist holdouts proved strained, but not entirely severed, following the death of her treacherous master. If she can be found in the galaxy’s seedy underbelly and the price is right, she may deign to return to service.

Ventress utilizes the Last Call, a specially commissioned Ginivex-class starfighter built by the Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective. Exuding lethal grace, the Last Call combines high-end weaponry with Geonosian solar sail technology that enables truly jaw-dropping aerial takedowns. Four light repeating laser cannons maintain a continuous cyclic rate thanks to the ship’s advanced power system, shredding anything in their path, while a seeker torpedo launcher can serve as a finishing blow or threaten enemy capital ships, all complemented by incredible speed and maneuverability.

Required Planets: Axxila, Brentaal, Constancia, Carida, Christophisis, Corellia, Cato_Neimoidia, Empress_Teta, Eriadu, Foerost, Fondor, Kuat, Mandalore, MonCalamari, Muunilinst, Neimoidia, Nar_Shaddaa, Orinda, Skarpos, Socorro, Sluis_Van, Taris, Corsin, Kriselist, Druckenwell, Hosnian_Prime, Isde_Nada, Botajef, Sleheyron, Zeltros, Randon

Cad Bane is a Duros mercenary and bounty hunter with decades of experience under his belt. He’s known for his amoral disposition and extreme competence in any job, often being considered one of the very best freelancers in the Galaxy. Though Bane is known (and feared) for his twin blasters, he’s proven skilled enough to successfully dogfight Jedi in his custom Rogue-class starfighter Xanadu Blood.

The Xanadu Blood is a highly modified Rogue-class heavy starfighter. It features a high-performance engine, heavy repeating laser cannons, and a cloaking device. Bane invested heavily in the ship’s control thrusters, enabling the otherwise unwieldy vessel to handle like a nimble interceptor—a capability that has surprised and led to the death of many foes.

Built by the Colicoid Creation Nest, the Trident-class Assault Droid is an unusual hybrid of warship and battle droid, capable of operating independently in both space and atmosphere. Originally designed to transport battle droids and attach itself to enemy vessels or installations for boarding operations, the Trident also proved to be an effective escort craft for larger Separatist warships.

Armed with heavy and medium laser cannons, the Trident excels at intercepting enemy starfighters, bombers, missiles, and torpedoes while shielding vulnerable capital ships from attack. Strong deflector shields and exceptional maneuverability make it difficult to destroy, though its limited firepower leaves it poorly suited for engaging enemy corvettes or larger warships.

Designed and built by Corellian Engineering Corporation prior to the Clone Wars, the Gozanti-class is a rugged and versatile workhorse long used by both the Republic and the Imperial Navy. Primarily an armed transport, the Gozanti can carry starfighters or light vehicles directly into combat using quick-release clamps mounted beneath its hull, allowing it to rapidly deploy and recover assets in contested space.

Armed with forward-firing proton torpedo launchers and twin heavy laser turrets providing near-total coverage, the Gozanti is capable of striking hardened targets or defending itself against enemy bombers. Deployable starfighter repair droids and onboard astromech systems allow it to support nearby fighters while maintaining its own combat readiness. Though slow and cumbersome, with a large and easily targeted profile, the Gozanti remains a valuable fleet support vessel where flexibility and endurance matter more than speed.

Required Planets: Corellia, Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen

Jango Fett is many things to many people: a cold killer, a mercenary, a liberator, and a devoted father. He shares the face that has been seen by trillions as the template for the Clone Army, but currently serves as a bounty hunter in the employ of the Confederacy. In one of life’s great ironies, he often finds himself forced to fight his own clones, men he personally helped train alongside fellow Mandalorian mercenaries. Jango wears sleek silver Mandalorian armor and travels the galaxy in his customized Firespray-31-class gunship, Slave I..

Slave I is a heavily modified Firespray-31-class patrol craft configured for bounty hunting and pursuit operations. Armed with twin medium repeating laser cannons, ion cannons, seeker torpedoes, and anti-starfighter missiles, it is well equipped to engage a wide variety of targets. The ship can also deploy seismic charges capable of devastating tightly grouped pursuing craft.

Weapons: x6 100mm High-Explosive/Armor-Piercing Autocannon

A cheap, mass-produced broadside anti-starfighter gunboat, the Trireme-class can inflict heavy damage to enemy fighters with its six 40mm high-explosive autocannons. While lightly armed and poorly shielded, the Trireme is equipped with powerful engines, allowing it to disengage from threats it cannot handle. Its cannons can switch between high-explosive shells for anti-starfighter work and armor-piercing rounds for engaging larger warships, providing limited fire support to friendly vessels. However, its extremely weak armor and shielding mean it will not survive long without support.

Weapons: x4 Heavy Concussion Missile Launcher, x6 Concussion Missile Launcher, x6 Light Turbolaser

The Lupus-class Missile Corvette is a light missile artillery platform that saw widespread use by the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo and the early Clone Wars. Trading durability for long-range firepower, it can be fielded in large numbers, making it popular among pirate groups and planetary militias seeking an inexpensive siege vessel.

Lightly armored and vulnerable in close engagements, the Lupus relies on distance to survive. Its limited self-defense armament of six light turbolasers offers little protection against determined attackers. Despite these shortcomings, the vessel remained in service with the Confederacy and later Separatist holdouts due to its low cost, ease of production, and minimal crew requirements.

A combat refit of the Techno Union’s famous Hardcell Transport, the Hardcell-class Gunboat was developed out of necessity as CIS capital ships suffered heavy losses to Republic bombers. It excels at engaging starfighters with its heavy laser turrets while harassing larger vessels using fixed forward turbolasers and concussion missiles.

The Hardcell possesses a resilient hull and respectable shielding, though its large target profile and sluggish handling require careful positioning to avoid enemy warships. Best employed as a screening vessel against fighters and bombers, it can also swarm and overwhelm weakened frigates alongside friendly forces.

SP: 500 (10/s), HP: 1000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.5, Agility: 1.45 Sensor Range: 2000m, Max Engagement Range: 3500m Active Abilities: None Passive Abilities: Missile Jammer

Weapons: x2 Light Turbolaser, x2 Ion Cannon, x2 Concussion Missile Launcher

The XX-777 Crusader-class Droid Platform, commonly known as the Droid Corvette, is a fully automated warship developed through a joint venture between Corellian Engineering and Loronar. Despite its Core World origins, the XX-777 saw widespread use within the Confederate Navy and later among Separatist holdout forces, aided by extensive corporate espionage networks.

Cheap, lightly armored, and barely shielded, the “triple seven” is built for simple, aggressive tactics, with all weapons mounted forward for direct assault runs and swarming attacks. It is armed with light turbolasers, ion cannons, and concussion missiles, allowing it to provide long-range ion fire support while also threatening corvettes and gunships. Highly maneuverable and equipped with a missile jamming system, the XX-777 relies on numbers rather than durability to survive.

The Petranaki, or “Justice” in Geonosian, is a thin, agile escort cruiser built for the Confederacy. Although equipped with rapid-firing light turbolaser turrets for basic self-defense, the Petranaki is generally helpless against other warships, but excels at escort duty and starfighter screening thanks to its specialized anti-starfighter weaponry. A passive point-defense system targets and destroys incoming ordnance from all angles, while two massive ball turrets equipped with proton beam cannons can decimate enemy starfighters at long range. Additional defenses in the form of several medium laser cannons and a bow-mounted discord missile launcher allow the vessel to maintain an impressive and continuous field of fire against swarms of enemy craft.

Manufactured by Gwori Revolutionary Industries and sold exclusively to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, the Devastation-class Gunboat was a fast, maneuverable strike craft designed for hit-and-run engagements. Its primary weapon, a fixed forward rotary heavy laser cannon, delivered impressive firepower but suffered from poor accuracy, especially at longer ranges.

Supplemented by light armor-piercing missiles and light turbolasers, the Devastation packs a respectable punch against starfighters, corvettes, and even lighter frigates. While its thick armor allows it to survive brief encounters with heavier ships, the gunboat’s notoriously fragile shield generator makes it ill-suited for prolonged firefights, and a few concentrated turbolaser blasts can quickly send it to the scrapyard. Agile and aggressive, it excels at harassing enemy flanks and disrupting formations before retreating to safety.

The Raxus-class Bulk Freighter serves as a vital logistics platform for the Confederate Navy. Designed for cargo transport and support operations, it carries only light armament—a dual turbolaser, heavy laser cannon, and concussion missile launcher—sufficient to deter minor threats but ineffective in sustained combat. Its stripped-down configuration maximizes cargo capacity and logistical systems. When deployed in orbit, the Bulk Freighter reduces production costs for allied units, strengthening supply lines and supporting prolonged operations. It can also deploy specialized jamming drones to intercept incoming enemy ordnance, providing limited defensive support to nearby friendly vessels.

Fleet Logistics & Protection: This unit provides a construction cost and time reduction of 15% to Corvettes, 10% to Frigates and 5% to Capital ships on the planet the Raxus Freighter is stationed. This bonus does not stack with multiple Raxus Freighters. In combat, it can deploy fields of jamming drones to jam incoming enemy ordnance.

The Raxus-class Combat Refit is a versatile corvette built on the frame of the original freighter, reengineered for frontline engagements and anti-corvette warfare. Armed with dual turbolaser turrets, heavy laser cannons, and a proton torpedo launcher, it delivers strong firepower in a compact platform, capable of disrupting enemy formations and engaging larger targets with precision. Improved power management allows it to divert reactor output to critical systems, while upgraded engines grant far greater maneuverability than its sluggish freighter predecessor.

Agile and well-armed, the Raxus Combat Refit excels in reconnaissance, harassment, and fleet screening roles. While not heavily armored, it is flexible and responsive, able to pressure lighter ships and support allied formations where needed.

SP: 2000 (50/s) HP: 3250, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 5, Agility: 0.65 Active Abilities: Hunt, Power To Engines Passive Abilities: None

Fast and highly maneuverable, the Affliction-class Strike Frigate was developed by Gwori Revolutionary Industries and fielded in limited numbers by the Confederacy early in the Clone Wars. Designed as a heavier counterpart to the Devastation-class gunboat, it retains a focus on speed and aggressive attack runs while carrying a more powerful weapons array. Its vertical-launch proton torpedoes and forward-fixed turbolasers allow it to hit far above its weight, but only when properly aligned for an attack.

The Affliction sacrifices durability for speed. Its armor is thin, its shielding minimal, and it cannot withstand sustained fire. It performs best in hit-and-run assaults or as part of a coordinated force, exploiting gaps in enemy formations before withdrawing to safety.

The Diamond-class Light Cruiser was originally built by the Commerce Guild as a heavily armored transport for troops, vehicles, and war materials before and during the Clone Wars. Impressed by its speed, reliability, and protection, the Confederacy of Independent Systems overhauled several hundred into frontline warships, designated the Diamond-class Combat Refit. These carried a pair of forward-firing turbolasers, supplemented by light turbolasers and heavy flak laser cannons mounted in turrets.

At just over 200 meters, the Diamond technically fell into the corvette category, yet packed the firepower of a light frigate. Its flak cannons and the ability to deploy large swarms of buzz droids made it a devastating area-denial platform against enemy bombers, while its turbolasers let it strike well above its weight. However, high production costs and the loss of Commerce Guild shipyards meant only limited numbers could be fielded before the war’s end.

The C-9980 Light Carrier represents a key advancement in Confederate fleet logistics, ensuring rapid and efficient deployment of droid starfighters across the galaxy. Derived from the proven C-9979 landing craft, the larger C-9980 is adapted exclusively for orbital operations, capable of carrying up to twelve squadrons of starfighters configured for any mission profile. Though minimally armed and armored, its compact design and hyperspace capabilities allow it to bolster front-line forces with overwhelming numbers of droid starfighters exactly where and when they are needed. In concert with the Confederacy's superior droid technology, the C-9980 ensures that no enemy can withstand the relentless tide of mechanized precision.

Derived from the proven C-9979 landing craft, the larger C-9980 is adapted exclusively for orbital operations, capable of carrying up to twelve squadrons of starfighters configured for any mission profile. Though minimally armed and armored, its compact design and hyperspace capabilities allow it to bolster front-line forces with overwhelming numbers of droid starfighters exactly where and when they are needed. In concert with the Confederacy's superior droid technology, the C-9980 ensures that no enemy can withstand the relentless tide of mechanized precision.

Originally designed by SoroSuub as a long-range cargo hauler, the Quasar Fire-class Bulk Cruiser was never intended for frontline combat. With the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, however, these freighters were hastily converted for military service by the Rebel Alliance and other sympathetic factions desperate for transport capacity. Robust, reliable, inexpensive, and easy to modify, the Quasar is commonly repurposed as a mobile hangar and supply ship, capable of ferrying large numbers of starfighters, troops, and vital materiel across the galaxy. Respectable armor and a modest weapons suite provide basic protection, but weak shields and painfully slow speed leave the Quasar best employed well behind the front lines.

The Quasar Fire-class Carrier grants all friendly fighters, bombers, and gunships +5% hull strength, +5% shield strength, and +10% movement speed.

Required Planets: Sullust

Developed by Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc. and Gwori Revolutionary Industries, the Munificent-class Star Frigate, also known as the Banking Clan Frigate, was designed for maximum efficiency and firepower. Though it possessed weak shielding, minimal structural integrity, and poor armor protection, the Munificent compensated with a powerful forward-facing arsenal that included a long-range medium ion cannon, a heavy turbolaser, and numerous rapid-firing dual light turbolasers. Extensive anti-starfighter weaponry further enhanced its offensive capabilities, though many of these weapons suffered from limited firing arcs.

Optimized for mass production and low operating costs, the Munificent required only 200 droids for operation and maintenance while carrying up to four squadrons of Vulture droids. Tens of thousands were produced for the Separatist fleet, with many remaining in service long after the Clone Wars. However, the ship’s weapons and overall design were heavily oriented toward frontal engagements, leaving it highly vulnerable on its flanks and completely defenseless from the rear.

Reserve max: 2x Tri_Fighter_Squadron

SP: 10000 (150/s), HP: 7500, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 3, Agility: 0.65 Sensor Range: 4000m, Max Engagement Range: 5000m Active Abilities: Sensor Jamming, Power To Shields Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

Weapons: x1 Medium Ion Cannon, x1 Heavy Turbolaser, x6 Heavy Flak Laser Cannon, x8 Quad Light Laser Cannon, x28 Dual Light Turbolaser

Complement: 2 Droid Tri-Fighter Squadron (2)

The “Zeta Variant” is a limited production series of the Munificent-class frigate developed by the alarmingly autonomous Super Tactical Droid, Kalani. Refining the already efficient Munificent design, Kalani’s modifications focus on near-total automation and high-performance microthrusters that dramatically improve maneuverability. This automation allows seamless integration into Kalani’s Fleet AI network, greatly enhancing the range, accuracy, and synchronization of the vessel’s weapon systems.

In addition, Zeta Variants are equipped with more powerful shield generators and an advanced electronic warfare suite capable of disrupting enemy sensors and targeting systems. Combined with exceptional agility and machine-precise coordination, Zeta hunting packs are capable of executing synchronized fleet maneuvers that eerily mimic Jedi battle meditation.

ONLY FIVE (5) VARIANTS CAN BE BUILT AT ONE TIME

Required Planets: Agamar
Special Structures: CIS_Shipyard_2 CIS_Uplink_Command

SP: 8000 (100/s), HP: 7500, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 3, Agility: 0.395 Sensor Range: 3500m, Max Engagement Range: 4500m Active Abilities: Power To Weapons Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

Developed by Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc. and Gwori Revolutionary Industries, the Munificent-class Star Frigate, also known as the Banking Clan Frigate, was designed for maximum efficiency and firepower. Though it possessed weak shielding, minimal structural integrity, and poor armor protection, the Munificent compensated with a powerful forward-facing arsenal that included a long-range medium ion cannon, a heavy turbolaser, and numerous rapid-firing dual light turbolasers. Extensive anti-starfighter weaponry further enhanced its offensive capabilities, though many of these weapons suffered from limited firing arcs.

Optimized for mass production and low operating costs, the Munificent required only 200 droids for operation and maintenance while carrying up to four squadrons of Vulture droids. Tens of thousands were produced for the Separatist fleet, with many remaining in service long after the Clone Wars. However, the ship’s weapons and overall design were heavily oriented toward frontal engagements, leaving it highly vulnerable on its flanks and completely defenseless from the rear.

SP: 17000 (200/s), HP: 6500, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.25, Agility: 0.25 Sensor Range: 2650m, Max Engagement Range: 4000m Active Abilities: Full Salvo (Ion Cannons), Power To Shields Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

Weapons: x1 Dual Ion Cannon, x1 Medium Ion Cannon, x1 Heavy Ion Cannon, x1 Repeating Turbolaser, x1 Dual Medium Turbolaser, x4 Light Ion Cannon

Developed by the Corporate Alliance, the Fantail-class Destroyer is a compact but highly specialized warship commonly employed in anti-piracy patrols and corporate security fleets throughout the Outer Rim. Within the Separatist Navy, the Fantail serves as a dedicated ion support platform, using its powerful forward-mounted ion weaponry to strip enemy shields and disable critical systems for follow-up attacks by allied warships.

Though protected by strong shields and respectable armor for its size, the Fantail suffers from slow speed, poor maneuverability, and an extremely narrow forward firing arc. Its primary weapons are fixed almost entirely toward the bow, leaving the vessel dangerously vulnerable at close range and nearly defenseless along its flanks and rear. Lacking meaningful anti-starfighter weaponry and conventional firepower, the Fantail performs best when protected by escorts and deployed behind the front line as a fleet support vessel.

SP: 4500 (30/s) HP: 3500 (3.75/s), Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 3, Agility: 0.25 Active Abilities: Deploy High-Explosive Bombs Passive Abilities: Astromech Repair

Weapons: x4 Heavy Armor-Piercing Missile Launcher, x6 Heavy Concussion Missile Launcher, x6 40mm Armor-Piercing Cannon

A deranged scientist known for both her cruelty and beauty, Jenna Zan Arbor is never one to let a minor obstacle like “ethics” stand in the way of scientific pursuit. Her long history as an independent researcher, along with her ties to the Confederacy, makes her a natural ally of the Separatist Holdout movement. Now re-tasked with advancing explosive yields and missile development, Zan Arbor is poised to propel the Confederacy into a new era of weapons research.

Jenna commands the Catalyst, an aging Lupus-class missile corvette dating back to the early Clone Wars. Refitted with a far deadlier payload of heavy armor-piercing and concussion missiles, along with 40-millimeter armor-piercing autocannons, the vessel has been adapted for devastating long-range strikes. Modest improvements to its shield generator and armor plating offer some added survivability, but the Catalyst remains a fragile siege platform at heart.

Research Leader: Jenna Zan Arbor’s strong R&D focus grants -50% construction time and -50% cost when building a Research Institute. Additionally, she greatly reduces the cost of advancing Tech Levels when ‘Escalating the War.’

Upgradable Hero - Must be present to upgrade Required Planet: Kessel System Required Tech: 4 Required Shipyard: Major Construction Yard

Her long history as an independent researcher, along with her ties to the Confederacy, makes her a natural ally of the Separatist Holdout movement. Now re-tasked with advancing explosive yields and missile development, Zan Arbor is poised to propel the Confederacy into a new era of weapons research.

As part of a research agreement with the Techno Union, Jenna conducts her field tests aboard a prototype Insolvence-class Ordnance Cruiser. SP: 75000 (650/s) HP: 100000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.5, Agility: 0.075 Active Abilities: Sensor Ping, Sensor Jamming Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

Weapons: x8 40mm High-Explosive Cannon, x8 Heavy Ion Cannon, x26 Quad Turbolaser

Marath Vooro is a Trade Federation Customs Vizier who refused to accept the Imperial–Trade Federation Treaty that transferred control of all Trade Federation assets to the Empire in the aftermath of the Clone Wars. Seizing what remained of the Trade Defense Force, he reactivated its dormant droid armies and, with the help of Separatist sympathizers, established control over Eriadu. Now ruling as a defiant holdout leader, Vooro commands his forces from his upgraded Lucrehulk-class carrier, Great Rapina.

The Great Rapina is a Lucrehulk-class carrier that Vooro has commanded since before the Clone Wars, now serving as the flagship of the Trade Defense Force. Upgraded with more powerful shields, heavy ion cannons, 40-millimeter high-explosive cannons, and a garrison of elite droid fighters, the vessel is well protected against a wide range of threats. Capable in both offensive and defensive roles, the Great Rapina excels as a durable command ship and carrier platform.

This repurposed MTC has been heavily modified by the Separatists into a dedicated long-range fire support platform. Armed with heavy armor-piercing missile launchers and quad turbolasers, it delivers accurate, punishing strikes from well beyond standard engagement ranges. However, minimal armor, poor maneuverability, and a near-total lack of close-range defenses leave it highly vulnerable to bombers and fast attack craft. Designed to operate under escort and away from the front lines, the fire support MTC reinforces CIS fleet actions with precise, long-range fire, so long as it remains protected.

Required Planets: Allanteen, Corellia, Fondor, Kuat, Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana

SP: 10000 (150/s) HP: 10000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 3, Agility: 0.06 Active Abilities: Missile Jammer Passive Abilities: None

Developed by the Techno Union as a mobile strategic weapons platform, the Insolvence-class Ordnance Cruiser was designed to annihilate hardened targets and heavily armored warships at extreme range. While it mounts three fixed, bow-mounted siege-grade turbolasers, the vessel’s true lethality lies in its high-yield proton missile payload. These missiles are powerful enough to tear capital ships apart with alarming efficiency, and their destructive potential was so extreme that their manufacture and possession were banned by the Galactic Senate, a restriction the Confederacy of Independent Systems openly ignored.

This overwhelming firepower comes at a severe cost. The cruiser’s volatile missile stores are highly unstable, and destruction of the vessel often results in catastrophic chain detonations. While devastating in long-range siege operations, the Insolvence is extremely vulnerable to focused fire, fast-moving strike craft, and sustained assaults. It is best deployed with a dedicated escort to screen incoming threats, as both enemies and nearby allies risk being caught in the massive explosion should the cruiser be destroyed.

This starship costs 300 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

SP: 6000 (500/s), HP: 12000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.5, Agility: 0.75 Sensor Range: 3000m, Max Engagement Range: 3500m Active Abilities: Full Salvo (Turbolasers), Power To Shields Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

A rail-thin warship built for low-cost production and precision strikes, the Overseer-class Frigate excels in direct ship-to-ship combat. Its primary weapons, medium turbolasers and armor-piercing missiles, rapidly tear through exposed hull plating once enemy shields collapse, while a devastating mass driver autocannon bypasses shields entirely to inflict crippling structural damage.

Though equipped with several light turbolasers for limited close-range defense, the Overseer lacks dedicated anti-starfighter weaponry and is almost completely helpless against bombers. Thin armor, slow speed, and minimal survivability make prolonged engagements extremely dangerous. However, its excellent maneuverability, fast-recharging shields, low production cost, and brutal alpha-strike potential make the Overseer a deadly glass cannon best used to strike hard before the enemy can respond.

Originally built as a bulk freighter by the Trade Federation, the Captor-class was retrofitted for combat and carrier operations as war loomed across the galaxy. Its anti-ship capabilities are modest—relying on a limited array of broadside heavy mass drivers—but it excels in starfighter defense with four heavy flak laser cannons providing full 360-degree coverage. A spacious internal hangar supports a wide variety of strikecraft, including the Confederacy’s most advanced starfighters and bombers, and is equipped with starfighter repair drones that can service nearby starfighters during engagements. Though not built for direct confrontation, the Captor serves as a vital support asset and should be kept behind the frontlines under proper escort.

Kalani is a Super Tactical Droid, long believed lost after the Separatist defeat at Onderon. Correctly perceiving the Droid Shutdown signal as a Republic trick, he went into exile—silently preparing to execute Battle Plan Zeta to its fullest extent: the total victory of CIS forces over any who would oppose them. Now, with a blank check and no oversight from the transitional Holdout leadership, a terrifying new force is rising in the galaxy.

The Super Tactical Droid uses the humble DH-Omni Support Vessel as his primary operations hub. While it appears outwardly similar in design and armament to standard models, any engineering review would reveal staggering internal upgrades. The networking array has been completely rebuilt around Kalani, allowing him to interface with the vessel directly. This advanced integration grants him direct control over any ship equipped with a droid brain, enabling unparalleled coordination and management during fleet engagements.

Disarray: The death of a commanding officer will cause panic amongst your troops, halting all combat efforts for a short time.

This hero provides the bonuses of a Fleet Admiral AND a DH-Omni Supply Ship. It does NOT stack with those units.

AI Synchronization: When deployed alongside Kalani, his localized copies optimize command and control of specially modified Munificent frigates. This grants Zeta Variants +10% fire range, +10% shield strength, and +35% movement speed. These bonuses do not stack with Fleet Admiral effects.

SP: 10000 (275/s), HP: 13500, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.5; Agility: 0.075

Weapons: x6 Dual Heavy Laser Cannon, x8 Quad Turbolaser

Complement: 2 Heavy Vulture Droid Squadron (6), 2 Adv. Hyena Droid Bomber Squadron (6)

Required Planets: Agamar

Originally developed by Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc. as a civilian bulk transport, the DH-Omni was repurposed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Lightly armed and defensively vulnerable, these massive vessels nonetheless proved invaluable as fleet support assets. Outfitted with master repair droids for servicing friendly ships, they excel at keeping fleets operational during prolonged engagements.

This unit provides fleet-wide combat bonuses: +5% Health, +10% Shields, and +10% Defensive Power. These bonuses do not stack with other DH-Omni effects, but do stack with bonuses from other categories. Bonus Category: 20

This starship costs 200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

SP: 10000 (150/s) HP: 16500, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 3.25, Agility: 0.35 Active Abilities: Heavy Tractor Beam Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

The Nexu-class Cruiser is a pre-Clone Wars design built for heavy reconnaissance and pursuit roles. Compact, powerfully armed, and easy to modify, it became a staple warship across the Outer Rim, favored by independent militaries and pirate fleets alike.

Equipped with a powerful tractor beam and a sizeable starfighter garrison, the Nexu was notorious for harassing merchant shipping. Its potent missile payload and strong defenses made it a threat not only to freighters, but also to capital ships many times its size. In fact, its widespread use by raiders is often cited as a key factor behind the Trade Federation’s militarization of its freighter fleet, an escalation that helped ignite the Clone Wars.

SP: 18000 (125/s) HP: 18000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 1.5, Agility: 0.15 Sensor Range: 3000m, Max Engagement Range: 4500m Active Abilities: Point Defense System (0.1s/1600m) Passive Abilities: None

Weapons: x1 Heavy Ion Cannon, x3 Dual Heavy Laser Cannon, x3 Quad Turbolaser, x8 40mm High-Explosive autocannon, x10 Medium High-Explosive Missile Launcher, x12 20mm High-Explosive Autocannon

A design by Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc., the Recusant-class Escort Destroyer was developed to counter the growing threat posed by Republic bombers such as the ARC-170 and BTL-B Y-Wing during the Clone Wars. Built primarily for fleet defense, it excels at protecting friendly ships from enemy starfighters and bombers, making it a valuable asset in maintaining the integrity of Separatist formations.

Armed with rapid-fire high-explosive cannons, heavy laser cannons, and medium high-explosive missiles, the Escort Destroyer can saturate the surrounding area with lethal anti-starfighter fire. An advanced point-defense system further enhances its effectiveness by intercepting incoming ordnance at long range. However, its anti-ship armament is limited to a modest number of quad turbolasers, while a long-range heavy ion cannon provides only minor support. Largely defenseless against anything larger than a corvette, the Escort Destroyer must be kept behind the line of contact, where it can fulfill its role as a dedicated fleet protector.

The Sabaoth-class Destroyer was built in secrecy by a mercenary outfit loyal to Count Dooku and deployed by the Confederacy during the early stages of the Clone Wars. Designed as a fast-attack destroyer, the Sabaoth carries a respectable starfighter complement alongside a versatile weapons loadout of turbolasers, ion cannons, concussion missiles, and rapid-fire 40mm high-explosive autocannons. This balanced arsenal allows the vessel to engage a wide range of threats, stripping shields and disabling warships with ion fire, inflicting heavy damage with concentrated turbolaser volleys, and screening friendly forces against enemy bombers and starfighters.

This starship costs 175 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

The Dreadnaught-class, officially designated the Rendili Support Cruiser, is a modern refit of a venerable pre-war Republic cruiser. Armed with a variety of turbolasers, laser cannons, ion cannons, and missiles, the Dreadnaught serves as a well-balanced, general-purpose heavy frigate suited for frontline assaults, fire support, and escort duty. A respectable starfighter garrison and tractor beam projector further enhance its versatility, while thick armor plating allows it to absorb a surprising amount of punishment. Despite these strengths, its weak shield generator, broadside-focused main armament, slow speed, and poor maneuverability leave it at a disadvantage against more modern warships.

Required Planets: Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen

Javelin-class heavy thrustship (CIS Combat Overhaul). To fulfill the need for heavily armored and armed frigates with better performance than the relatively weak Munificents, several Javelin thrustships were purchased by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and converted into heavily armed assault frigates to take on Republic capital ships. Armed with upgraded heavy laser cannons as well as specialized rapid-fire heavy turbolasers and proton torpedo launchers, these converted warships pack a serious punch and can give the CIS the edge it needs in combat against the otherwise superior Republic warships. The defensive countermeasures usually found on standard Javelins were removed to make room for a more powerful main reactor and shield generator.

Max speed: 5.25; Shield points: 8000; Hit points: 20000

The aberrant clone Alpha-Ø2 “Spar” inherited the memories of Jango Fett and escaped Kamino before he could be put down. Fueled by his memories of Fett and his bonding with his Mandalorian trainers, this experience would be the catalyst for his awakening as a Mandalorian-nationalist and fierce opponent of the Republic. He would go on to incredible victories as the leader of the reformed Mandalorian Protectors, becoming known as “Mandalore the Resurrector” for his commitment to traditionalism. He has since joined the Protectors to the cause of the Confederacy of Independent Systems in a bid to strike down the Republic once and for all.

Required Planets: Mandalore
Special Structures: CIS_Shipyard_3 CIS_Uplink_Command

SP: 15000 (125/s) HP: 30000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2, Agility: 0.065 Sensor Range: 2750m, Max Engagement Range: 4500m Active Abilities: Heavy Tractor Beam Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

Weapons: x1 Heavy Mass Driver, x1 Heavy Turbolaser, x2 Quad Heavy Laser Cannon, x4 Quad Turbolaser, x20 Heavy Armor-Piercing Missile Launcher

The Invincible-class Heavy Cruiser is an aging warship dating back to the Old Republic, designed during an era when massive capital ships ruled the stars before advances in weapons and starfighter technology rendered many such vessels obsolete. Surprisingly cheap and easy to acquire in the modern age, these cruisers are best suited for anti-piracy operations and fleet fire support rather than frontline engagements.

Its primary armament, consisting of a heavy mass driver and a heavy turbolaser, are fixed forward, while multiple quad turbolasers and heavy laser cannons provide flank coverage. Secondary weapons include a complement of heavy armor-piercing missiles capable of devastating armored targets with ease. However, lacking ion weaponry, the Invincible-class struggles against heavily shielded opponents and is utterly defenseless against bomber attacks.

This starship costs 200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

Required Planets (Empire, Neutral, CIS, Rebel, Republic, Underworld): Etti_IV, Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen

This former Republic Venator-class Star Destroyer has been captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and pressed into service to fight against its former owners. Painted in the colors of the Confederacy and bearing the emblem of the Separatists, this ship is now crewed entirely by B1 and OOM Battle Droids. While its hangars are now stocked with hundreds of droid starfighters, the ship is otherwise unchanged. Maintenance costs for this ship run higher than usual due to a lack of parts and adequate facilities.

This starship costs 450 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

Required Planets: Kuat, Fondor, Kamino, Rendili, Rothana, Corellia, Allanteen, Coruscant, Ringo_Vinda

Providence-class Destroyer/Carrier. While the original design for this ship started at the shipyards of Rendilli StarDrive, production was carried out by the Quarren Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps following the onset of the Clone Wars. Built as a sturdy frontline warship for the Confederacy, the Providence-class is armed with a plethora of devastating broadside weaponry operated by its droid crew. Its strong armor and shields, coupled with a massive central hangar housing hundreds of droid starfighters, enable it to take on the toughest Republic warships.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 30000 (300/s); Hit points: 40000

Weapons: x1 Heavy Ion Cannon, x2 Advanced Proton Torpedo Launcher, x4 Dual Ion Cannon, x4 Advanced Turbolaser, x4 Dual Heavy Laser Cannon, x4 Heavy Flak Laser Cannon, x14 Quad Turbolaser

Developed by the Quarren Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps, the Allocator-class is a heavily armed frontline destroyer built for direct engagements and precision fire-support. Equipped with reinforced armor and powerful deflector shields, it can endure heavy fire while unleashing devastating salvos from its forward-mounted siege weapons. Though designed to operate independently when needed, the Allocator is most effective when integrated into a coordinated assault. Its high-output engines allow for short bursts of speed, making it well-suited to pursue fleeing enemies or reposition in the heat of battle.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 35000; Hit points: 40250

General Grievous is viewed within the Confederacy as a necessary evil—an unflinching commander whose ruthless methods promise swift victories, though at a terrible moral cost. His brutal efficiency is tolerated by Separatist leadership, who value results above conscience. To the wider galaxy, however, Grievous is remembered as a war criminal, a butcher who left worlds in ruins and fleets in ashes, sculpted by Sith ambition and technological obsession.

At the height of the Clone Wars, Grievous commands the Invisible Hand, the most infamous warship of the conflict. This Providence-class dreadnought is versatile and deadly, able to deliver brutal close-quarters broadsides or punishing long-range barrages with reinforced turbolasers. Its upgraded shielding and expanded hangars allow it to endure sustained fire and unleash endless droid starfighters. To board it is a death sentence: Grievous and his IG-100 MagnaGuards ensure their commander’s reign of terror continues unchecked.

Max Speed: 2.75; Shield points: 35000 (500/s); Hit Points: 45000

Complement: 2 Heavy Vulture Droid Squadron (8), 2 Droid Tri-Fighter Squadron (6), 1 Belbullab-22 Squadron (4), 1 Belbullab-24 Squadron (4), 1 IG-100 MagnaGuard Squadron (2)

Weapons: x1 Quad Ion Cannon, x2 Heavy Proton Torpedo Launcher, x4 Heavy Flak Laser Cannon, x4 Heavy Ion Cannon, x4 Heavy Turbolaser, x4 Advanced Turbolaser, x14 Advanced Quad Turbolaser

Fleet commander: General Grievous emphasizes overwhelming force over mobility, granting +25% shields, +20% defense, and +30% damage to frigates, capitals, and dreadnaughts—but reduces their speed by 30%.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Admiral Trench was one of the most formidable strategic minds of the Clone Wars and has proven very hard to kill. Nearly dying twice at the hands of the Republic, the aging Confederate admiral rode out the Empire’s rise after securing hardened bunkers on Ringo Vinda. Trench has since eked out a dangerous life as a guerilla fighter until receiving Gizor Dellso’s reactivation signals. He brings a lifetime of naval experience and brutally efficient tactics to the CIS Transitional government.

Trench’s Invincible II is a Providence-class Dreadnought variant that notably features larger reactors below the main hangars. Though they reduce the hangar size and lower the overall squadron capacity, this design allows for greater weapon and shield power compared to standard destroyer variants. The Invincible II also comes equipped with heavier weapons, including a heavy mass driver, heavy concussion missiles, and a powerful sextuple turbolaser turret.

Max Speed: 3; Shield Points: 35000 (300/s); Hit Points: 45000

Weapons: x1 Heavy Mass Driver, x1 Sextuple Heavy Turbolaser, x2 Heavy Concussion Missile Launcher, x4 Dual Medium Laser Cannon, x4 Heavy Flak Laser Cannon, x4 Quad Ion Cannon, x4 Dual Medium Turbolaser, x14 Quad Turbolaser

Complement: 2 Heavy Vulture Droid Squadron (4), 2 Droid Tri-Fighter Squadron (4), 4 Hyena Droid Bomber Squadron (8), 2 HMP Droid Gunship Squadron (4)

Fleet commander: Admiral Trench’s siege doctrine grants +25% shields, +20% defense, and +15% health to frigates, capitals, and dreadnaughts—at the cost of 30% reduced speed.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Designed by Hoersch-Kessel Drive Inc. and produced by the Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps, the Recusant-class Destroyer, also known as the Commerce Guild Destroyer, was built for efficiency and mass production. Operated primarily by droids, its skeletal frame minimizes armor to only essential components, relying instead on strong shielding and long-range firepower. Favoring standoff engagements, the Recusant is vulnerable at close range.

Lacking ion weaponry, the Recusant instead mounts an extensive array of turbolasers capable of saturating targets from multiple angles, allowing it to quickly overwhelm lighter warships. A small number of medium laser cannons and a modest droid starfighter complement provide limited protection against bombers, but it remains vulnerable to sustained strikecraft attacks. Best employed as a force multiplier, the Recusant excels when supporting larger formations with coordinated long-range barrages.

Recovered and reactivated after the Battle of Naboo, OOM-9 is a veteran battle droid commander repurposed for naval warfare by Gizor Dellso. Known for his decisive command style, he favors direct assaults and sustained firepower to overwhelm enemy defenses. What began in the swamps of Naboo now continues in orbit, as OOM-9 executes his directive with mechanical precision: destroy the Republic. All other considerations are irrelevant.

OOM-9 commands the Recusant-class Heavy Destroyer he calls "Tank". Heavily armed with ion cannons, heavy flak lasers, and super heavy proton torpedoes, and reinforced with upgraded armor and shielding, Tank is far deadlier and more resilient than a standard Recusant, albeit slower and more cumbersome.

Gizor Dellso is a Geonosian engineer responsible for the creation of the CIS Command Signal, a failsafe to ensure that the Battle Droid army could never be turned against their Separatist masters. The Sith used this same signal to swiftly end the Clone Wars, following the Separatist Council's betrayal and murder. However, Gizor did not accept defeat. His recapture and rearmament of Mustafar have since launched him into a key leadership role of the insurgency.

The Intemptor is a Providence-class destroyer/carrier commanded by the Geonosian engineer Gizor Dellso. Upgraded with a highly advanced prototype shield generator array, the Intemptor can withstand far more punishment than other ships of its class. Gizor also personally modified the ship’s weapons systems, installing plasma torpedo launchers in the bow and an additional four quad turbolaser turrets with wide fields of fire. In addition to its powerful upgrades, its hangar bay is packed with the latest high-end prototype starfighters available to the CIS, giving it a decisive edge in carrier-based operations.

Max Speed: 2.5; Shieldpoints: 40000; Hitpoints: 45000

Weapons: x1 Heavy Ion Cannon, x2 Plasma Torpedo Launcher, x4 Dual Ion Cannon, x4 Heavy Flak Laser Cannon, x4 Advanced Turbolaser, x4 Heavy Dual Laser Cannon, x18 Quad Turbolaser

Complement: 2 Heavy Vulture Droid Squadron (8), 2 Adv. Hyena Droid Bomber Squadron (8), 1 HMP Droid Gunship Squadron (4)

Required Planets: Mustafar
Special Structures: CIS_Shipyard_3 CIS_Uplink_Command

Gizor Dellso is a Geonosian engineer responsible for the creation of the CIS Command Signal, a failsafe to ensure that the Battle Droid army could never be turned against their Separatist masters. The Sith used this same signal to swiftly end the Clone Wars, following the Separatist Council's betrayal and murder. However, Gizor did not accept defeat. His recapture and rearmament of Mustafar have since launched him into a key leadership role of the insurgency.

The Picador, named after the mounted gladiatorial warriors of Geonosis, is a customized Providence-class dreadnought commissioned for Dellso following his successful liberation campaign in the Southern Rim. Heavily reinforced with additional armor plating and an upgraded shield generator, this ship boasts a unique indigenous weapons suite and a devastating experimental proton lance system—capable of bypassing shields and inflicting incredible damage in the blink of an eye.

Max Speed: 3.5; Shieldpoints: 50000; Hitpoints: 50000

SP: 75000 (500/s) HP: 75000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.5, Agility: 0.075 Active Abilities: Sensor Ping, Sensor Jamming Passive Abilities: None

Weapons: x8 Dual Heavy Laser Cannon, x26 Quad Turbolaser

Designed and built by Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc. as the LH-3210 Cargo Freighter, the Lucrehulk-class was purchased in large numbers by the Trade Federation and later, the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Originally armed to deter rampant piracy along major trade routes, the Lucrehulk’s immense size and structural strength made it well suited for further militarization. With relatively minor modifications, these armed freighters were converted into full warships and redesignated as Lucrehulk-class Carriers or Droid Control Ships. In this role, they carried thousands of droid starfighters, millions of battle droids, and hundreds of combat vehicles, allowing a single vessel to blockade, assault, and occupy entire planets with minimal support.

This starship costs 1800 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

Originally a civilian starliner, the Dauntless-class was repurposed into a heavy warship by the SoroSuub Corporation and is now one of the most formidable capital ships available on the black market. Armed with ten heavy quad turbolasers and ten heavy laser cannons, it excels in brutal broadside engagements, capable of holding its own against most military-grade warships with sustained fire. While equipped with redundant shield generators, their overall output is relatively weak—making the Dauntless highly susceptible to ion weaponry.

However, this vulnerability is balanced by its exceptionally thick, layered durasteel armor, which can absorb heavy punishment from turbolasers and missiles alike. A respectable fighter garrison and powerful defensive weaponry help deter smaller threats, but like most capital ships, the Dauntless is sluggish and an easy target for massed bomber wings. It should never operate without a capable escort.

Max speed: 2.0; Shield points: 20000; Hit points: 75000

Weapons: x10 Heavy Laser Cannon, x10 Quad Heavy Turbolaser

Complement: 1 Droid Tri-Fighter Squadron (1), 2 Vulture Droid Squadron (2)

Required Planets: Sullust

SP: 75000 (500/s) HP: 100000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.5, Agility: 0.075 Active Abilities: Sensor Ping, Sensor Jamming Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment, Battlefield Salvage

Weapons: x8 Dual Heavy Laser Cannon, x8 Quad Ion Cannon, x26 Quad Turbolaser

Complement: 10 Vulture Droid Squadron (80), 10 Hyena Droid Bomber Squadron (80)

Many call Nute Gunray a coward. But could a coward claw his way out of the gutters of Cato Neimoidia with nothing? Could a coward broker deals with the most dangerous and powerful figures in the galaxy, or take the risks that Gunray has? Ultimately, Viceroy Nute Gunray is known as the leader of the Trade Federation and a primary architect of the Clone Wars. He commands vast industrial resources and maintains business connections across the galaxy. His greed and bloodlust know no bounds, his ruthless efficiency is feared galaxy-wide, and his ability to evade capture and death time and again has become legend.

Nute Gunray’s vessel, the Jewel of the Rim, is an aging Trade Federation Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 freighter refit, favored for its lack of livery or identifying markings. Before his allegiances were openly known, plausible deniability was often as effective as a blaster. The Jewel of the Rim is outfitted with several quad ion cannons in addition to its standard complement of turbolasers and laser cannons. This added ion weaponry gives the ship a decisive edge in engagements, allowing it to disable enemy vessels and deter would-be attackers.

War Profiteer: Nute Gunray’s connections grant him a large bonus to his Military-Industrial base, resulting in a 25% cost reduction for Separatist ships, regiments, and buildings. Additionally, he has the Salvage effect in combat, granting the player credits per kill when the Viceroy is deployed.

SP: 75000 (750/s) HP: 125000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2, Agility: 0.075 Active Abilities: Full Salvo (Turbolasers) Passive Abilities: None

Weapons: x16 Quad Heavy Laser Cannon, x38 Quad Turbolaser

Complement: 10 Vulture Droid Squadron (90)

Many Lucrehulk-class carriers were modified into dedicated battlecruisers. Featuring reinforced armor plating, additional quad turbolaser batteries linked to advanced targeting systems, and more powerful shield generators, these warships could outgun most Republic vessels and can still stand up to many heavy Star Destroyers today.

Despite their increased protection and firepower, they are ironically more vulnerable to bomber attacks than their carrier counterparts. Their quad heavy laser cannons are designed to supplement the main turbolaser batteries and lack the accuracy needed to reliably engage enemy starfighters.

A derelict Lucrehulk-class battleship in abysmal condition, this vessel is barely spaceworthy. Maintenance costs alone nearly outweigh its value. Much of its weaponry and armor have been scavenged, its shield generator operates at reduced capacity, and refuse and debris block much of the hangar space, severely limiting its carrying capability.

SP: 275000 (2250/s) HP: 200000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 4, Agility: 0.045 Sensor Range: 25000m, Max Engagement Range: 6250m Active Abilities: Fire Heavy Ion-Pulse Blast Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment

Weapons: x1 Heavy Ion-Pulse Blast Cannon, x9 Dual Heavy Laser Cannon, x14 Dual Heavy Turbolaser, x146 Dual Turbolaser

Complement: 12 Vulture Droid Squadron (48), 4 Droid Tri-Fighter Squadron (16), 4 HMP Droid Gunship Squadron (16)

The Subjugator-class Battlecruiser was among the largest and most formidable warships fielded by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Armed with heavy turbolasers, heavy laser cannons, numerous dual turbolasers, and a pair of devastating broadside heavy ion-pulse cannons, it could overwhelm conventional fleets through sheer firepower while disabling enemy warships in massive numbers.

Its heavy ion-pulse cannons were capable of crippling entire task forces or planetary defenses in a single salvo. However, the Subjugator's massive profile and poor maneuverability left it highly vulnerable when outnumbered or outflanked, forcing it to rely on escorts and starfighters for protection. Despite these weaknesses, it remains infamous as one of the deadliest symbols of Separatist naval power.

The Ion-Pulse Cannon disables anything in its path, reducing enemy firepower by 75% and speed by 99% for 15 minutes. To use, order the Subjugator to face (forward NOT broadside) its target with a right-click, then activate the ability. The Subjugator will then execute the firing order by rotating into position.

Once committed, this vessel cannot retreat until the battle is over.

This starship costs 3600 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

Required Planets (Empire, CIS, Rebel, Underworld): Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost, MonCalamari, Geonosis

The Subjugator II-class Heavy Battlecruiser is an extensive modernization of the original Subjugator, replacing its broadside ion-pulse cannons with a pair of forward-facing ultra-heavy turbolasers. Capable of destroying most light frigates in a single salvo and rapidly tearing apart larger warships, these devastating weapons transform the vessel into a dedicated capital ship killer. Dual heavy ion cannons continuously strip enemy shields, while rapid-fire 40mm high-explosive autocannons and an expanded complement of advanced droid starfighters provide exceptional protection against enemy bombers and starfighters.

Additional armor plating and reinforced shield generators significantly improve the Subjugator II's survivability. However, its immense size, poor maneuverability, narrow forward firing arc, and lengthy weapon recharge leave little room for error. Commanders must keep the vessel's bow trained on priority targets to unleash its full destructive potential.

Once committed, this vessel cannot retreat until the battle is over.

This starship costs 5250 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost, MonCalamari, Geonosis
Special Structures: CIS_Shipyard_3

Developed by Incom as a simplified successor to the Clone Wars–era Z-95 CVI, the Z-95 Headhunter was designed to be inexpensive, rugged, and easy to mass-produce. Many of the complex and maintenance-heavy systems of its predecessor were deliberately stripped away, resulting in a straightforward general-purpose starfighter well suited to militias, planetary defense forces, and pirates. While clearly outclassed by modern starfighters, the Z-95 remains serviceable thanks to its reliability, wide availability, and flexible design. Of particular note is its modular ordnance launcher system, allowing the Headhunter to carry either missiles or torpedoes depending on mission requirements. Long past its prime, the Z-95 endures not through superiority, but through affordability, familiarity, and adaptability.

Developed from the standard Z-95 Headhunter, the Z-95 “Hullcracker” is a strike-focused variant that leverages the fighter’s modular ordnance launcher to replace concussion missiles with proton torpedoes. This simple modification allows the Hullcracker to function as a light, low-cost bomber capable of threatening capital ships and orbital installations. Poorly armored and lightly defended, it is undeniably crude by modern military standards, but its affordability and ease of maintenance have made it a favorite among pirates, criminal syndicates, and irregular forces. When deployed in numbers, the Hullcracker can overwhelm point defenses and deliver surprisingly devastating damage, ensuring it remains a threat that cannot be safely ignored.

The massive PT-1 Gunship is a strange and unconventional design originally commissioned by the Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps of Naboo. Built as a fast anti-starfighter platform, the PT-1 is essentially two enormously powerful engines attached to a large dual crew module and a broad, one-piece armored wing that forms most of the craft’s structure. Armed with heavy laser cannons and high-explosive missiles, it was intended to obliterate enemy squadrons in a single devastating volley before retreating at extreme speed.

A mixed group of CEC YT-series light freighters, commonly used across the galaxy by traders, smugglers, and pirates due to their modular and easily modified design. While these examples lack the extensive custom upgrades seen on famous vessels like the Millennium Falcon or Outrider, they retain the durability and versatility that made the platform so popular.

Equipped with turreted laser cannons offering wide firing coverage, these freighters can function as makeshift gunships. Heavy armor and shielding allow them to absorb punishment, while their respectable agility for ships of their size lets them support starfighters and lay down sustained fire during dogfights.

The Bothan Assault Frigate 4 (BAF-4), produced by Bothawui Shipyards, was envisioned as a versatile backbone warship that could be deployed in large numbers across the front. Outfitted with strong shields but relatively weak armor, the BAF-4 relied on staying power rather than brute endurance. Its varied and extensive armament—including ion cannons, heavy laser cannons, advanced proton torpedoes, concussion missile launchers, dual turbolasers, and heavy flak lasers—allowed it to effectively engage a wide array of targets.

A spacious internal hangar housed up to four squadrons of mixed strike craft, giving the frigate added flexibility in fleet actions. Though it lacked specialization in any one area, its balanced design made the BAF-4 a dependable jack-of-all-trades vessel, capable of adapting to whatever the battlefield demanded—so long as it wasn’t outmatched in raw firepower or durability.

Max speed: 4.35; Shield points: 12000; Hit points: 9500

Weapons: x2 Advanced Proton Torpedo Launcher, x2 Ion Cannon, x4 Quad Heavy Laser Cannon, x2 Heavy Flak Laser Cannon, x8 Concussion Missile, x8 Dual Turbolaser

Complement: 1 Z-95 Headhunter Squadron (1), 1 Z-95 Hullcracker Squadron (1)

This starship costs 375 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.

SP: 10000 (100/s); HP: 11500, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 2.75, Agility: 0.2 Active Abilities: Power To Weapons, Medium Tractor Beam Passive Abilities: None

Weapons: x8 Triple Turbolaser, x22 Heavy Laser Cannon

Complement: 1 Belbullab-22 Squadron (1), 1 Belbullab-24 Squadron (1)

Designed and produced by Rendilli StarDrive decades before the Clone Wars, the Neutron Star–class was an early Republic-era frigate intended to serve dual roles as both a warship and a bulk transport. Often referred to simply as a “bulk cruiser,” the class became a common sight along major trade routes and patrol sectors, its silhouette familiar enough to be casually dismissed by smugglers and spacers alike. By the time of the Clone Wars, however, the design was already showing its age, having been eclipsed by newer and more capable Rendilli warships such as the Dreadnaught-class Heavy Cruiser. As a result, the Neutron Star saw only limited frontline service and was largely relegated to secondary duties.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Neutron Star endured as a cheap and readily available alternative to modern capital ships, pressed into service by the Empire and local defense forces for patrol and anti-piracy operations. Armed with several triple turbolasers and numerous heavy laser cannons, it is capable of delivering steady, sustained fire, but its complete lack of ion weaponry or missile launchers leaves it poorly suited to engaging heavily shielded or armored opponents. Mediocre armor protection, merely adequate shields, and a small starfighter complement further underscore its limitations. Long obsolete as a true warship, the Neutron Star nonetheless lives on in widespread use among criminal syndicates and paramilitary forces, valued not for its strength, but for its availability, simplicity, and low cost.

Required Planets: Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen

The Gladiator-class Strike Carrier is a late Clone Wars–era design from Kuat Drive Yards, developed as a general-purpose carrier and heavy frigate. Equipped with large internal hangars for a substantial starfighter complement, the Gladiator combines fleet support capabilities with respectable frontline firepower. Though not intended for prolonged combat against heavier warships, its versatile arsenal of ion cannons, armor-piercing missiles, and turbolasers allows it to overwhelm corvettes and lighter frigates with ease. Compact, flexible, and heavily armed for its size, the Gladiator remained effective long after the Clone Wars and continued to serve throughout the reign of the Empire.

Required Planets: Kuat, Fondor

SP: 10000 (100/s), HP: 12000, Armor: Starship, Max Speed: 3, Agility: 0.28 Sensor Range: 2450m, Max Engagement Range: 2850m Active Abilities: Medium Tractor Beam, Gravity Well Generator Passive Abilities: Orbital Bombardment, Point Defense System (0.65s/1350m)

Weapons: x2 Dual Turbolaser, x6 Heavy Laser Cannon, x10 Light Turbolaser

The Immobilizer-class Interdictor Frigate is a specialized support vessel built upon a modified Vindicator hull, adapted to accommodate powerful gravity well projectors and the enlarged reactor required to power them. These systems can forcibly pull ships from hyperspace and prevent enemy vessels from escaping into lightspeed. It also features a sophisticated long-range point-defense array that is highly effective against torpedoes, missiles, and other enemy ordnance.

The immense power requirements and internal volume occupied by the gravity well projectors leave little room for heavy armor or offensive weaponry. As a result, the Immobilizer suffers from weak shields, light armor, and only modest armament sufficient to defend itself against light warships. It is a support vessel first and foremost, relying on friendly escorts to protect it from direct engagement.

Required Planets: Kuat, Fondor
Special Structures: CIS_Shipyard_2

A high-performance starfighter designed by the Hapes Consortium, the Miy’Tok features an advanced power management system and dual solar sails that generate excess energy for its engines, shields, and weapons. This allows for extremely high speed, rapidly recharging shields, and repeating laser cannons capable of sustained, uninterrupted fire. These advantages come at a cost. The Miy’Tok’s handling is mediocre, and its large profile and light armor make it an easy target for enemies that manage to get behind it.

This unit is unaffected by nebulas.

The Miy’Til Bomber is a fast, durable heavy strike craft deployed by the Hapes Consortium for precision attacks against enemy capital ships. Emphasizing speed and survivability, it can outrun most starfighters, especially when diverting additional power to its already powerful engines. Designed for rapid hit-and-run strikes, the Miy’Til can heavily debuff enemy shields and armor to support friendly fighters, or remain on target to inflict serious damage with its heavy laser cannons. Best employed against large warships, it excels at weakening hostile vessels and creating openings for the rest of the Hapan Starfleet to exploit.

This unit is unaffected by nebulas.

Hapan Battle Dragon: The primary ship of the line for the Hapan Royal Navy, the Battle Dragon is as elegant as it is efficient. It maintains a surprising volume of firepower on a single target by synchronizing its weapon reload cycle with the rotation of its dual dish-mounted turrets. Despite its relatively small size, this allows the Dragon to unleash a concentrated hail of turbolaser and ion cannon fire. However, this optimized firing pattern can only be directed at one target at a time, limiting its effectiveness against multiple enemies.

Max speed: 3.0; Shieldpoints: 8000; Hitpoints: 8000

Weapons: x16 Revolving Turbolaser, x12 Revolving Ion Cannon, Concussion Missile System (16 missiles)

Complement: 1 Miy'Tok Fighter Squadron (1), 1 Miy'Til Bomber Squadron (1)

This unit is unaffected by nebulas.

The Basilisk War Droid is an ancient Mandalorian assault craft, revived in modern form as a fast, heavily armored strike platform. Its forward-facing weapons suite is designed for overwhelming close-range attacks, allowing it to tear through lightly armored starfighters with devastating volleys. Foldable wings grant bursts of speed for rapid ambushes or quick disengagements, making the Basilisk a dangerous hit-and-run attacker.

True to Mandalorian Neo-Crusader doctrine, the Basilisk sacrifices shields and pilot protection in favor of brute offensive power and durability. While vulnerable to sustained fire from heavier warships, these semi-sentient war machines excel when unleashed against fighter screens, where their concentrated firepower can shred entire squadrons in moments.

The Mandal Hypernautics StarViper Attack Platform (SVAP-2) is the mass-producible evolution of Prince Xizor’s personal starfighter, Virago. While the Virago was meant to be the only craft of its kind, Mandal Hypernautics reacquired the production rights and designed a version suitable for mass production: the SVAP-2. Although the standard StarViper is less powerful, it remains an astonishingly advanced and capable starfighter, with the price tag to match. Extremely maneuverable thanks to its armored maneuvering fins, and highly durable due to strong shields and beskar-inlaid armor, the StarViper also features an advanced targeting system for its swiveling weapon mounts, allowing the craft to maintain an accurate and wide field of fire.

While durable, the large StarViper presents a substantial frontal target profile, making it vulnerable to even inaccurate weaponry when its S-foils are locked in the attack position. It is especially susceptible to missiles and torpedoes, relying on countermeasure flares for temporary protection. Despite this vulnerability, the StarViper is a top-of-the-line assault fighter capable of engaging a variety of targets and excelling in dogfights.

Known in Mando’a as “Ambush,” the Je’Havey is a compact but heavily armored assault ship developed by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders for shock warfare. Armed with rapid-firing turbolasers, ion cannons, and concussion missile launchers, it was designed to operate in coordinated packs, encircling enemy formations and annihilating them under a relentless crossfire. Though officially classified as a corvette due to its size, the Je’Havey carries the armor protection and offensive output of a light frigate, making it far deadlier than its silhouette suggests and a terror in close-range fleet actions.

Once the backbone of the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader fleet during the Mandalorian Wars, the Kyramud-class Battleship is a relic of brutalist warship design. Despite its imposing insectoid frame and sheer mass, the Kyramud carries surprisingly limited direct-fire weaponry for a ship of its size. Instead, it leans into overwhelming resilience—encased in a near-impenetrable beskar shell and protected by a shield generator of absurd output, the Kyramud is notoriously difficult to bring down. Its primary offensive capability lies in long-range bombardment, unleashing devastating volleys from ten heavy concussion missile launchers. Supported by a contingent of Basilisk war droids for close defense and boarding actions, the Kyramud is less a brawler and more a slow-moving fortress—unyielding, unrelenting, and built to endure.

Max speed: 2.0; Shield points: 100000; Hit points: 35000

Weapons: x1 Dual Heavy Turbolaser, x2 Quad Medium Turbolaser, x2 Heavy Ion Cannon, Heavy Concussion Missile System (10 missiles)

Complement: 2 Basilisk Wardroid Squadron (6)

Named after the capital city of Mandalore, the Keldabe-class embodies the raw strength and unrelenting aggression of Mandalorian war doctrine. Its weapon systems include dual heavy ion cannons and dual heavy turbolasers for long-range engagements, supported by standard dual turbolasers and heavy laser cannons for brutal close-range brawling. The ship’s most fearsome weapons, however, are its heavy and ultra-heavy mass drivers, mounted in armored beskar housings and capable of tearing through enemy warships before they ever get into range. Designed to go head-to-head with the strongest ships in the galaxy, the Keldabe is widely regarded as one of the most feared capital ships in known space.

Max Speed: 3; Shieldpoints: 25000; Hitpoints: 50000

Weapons: x2 Super Heavy Mass Driver, x4 Dual Heavy Ion Cannon, x6 Heavy Mass Driver, x12 Dual Turbolaser, x12 Dual Heavy Turbolaser, x20 Heavy Laser Cannon

This starship costs 1180 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep.
